requirements_summary.summary: Participium is a web application for the Municipality of Turin enabling citizens to report urban issues (e.g., potholes, trash) via an interactive map and form. Reports undergo a lifecycle: Pending Approval -> Assigned (to Technical Office) -> In Progress -> Resolved/Rejected/Suspended. The system supports external maintainers (with or without platform access) for specific categories like Public Lighting. Features include anonymous reporting, multi-channel notifications (platform, email, Telegram bot), public/private statistics, and role-based access control for citizens, staff, administrators, and external partners.

requirements.text:
As an unregistered user
I want to see approved reports on an interactive map 
So that I can know about issues in my area and beyond.
expected_behaviors: I can know about issues in my area and beyond

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to assign reports to external maintainers
So that specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention.
constraints: It can be possible for specific reports of certain categories (e.g., Enel X for category Public Lighting) based on their content reviewed by the technical office staff member.
expected_behaviors: specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention

requirements.text:
As an external maintainer 
I want to update the status of a report assigned to me
So that I can updated citizens about  the intervention.
expected_behaviors: I can updated citizens about  the intervention

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member/external maintainer
I want to exchange information and comments on the report internally
So that coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens
expected_behaviors: coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to register with my name and username 
So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
constraints: Registration is required before submitting reports.
expected_behaviors: I can access the Participium system and submit reports

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to confirm my registration with a code
So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
constraints: Once a registration is completed, the user gets an email with a confirmation code. The person can use the application only after confirming by entering the code valid for 30 minutes.
expected_behaviors: my account becomes valid and I can start using the system

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to set up municipality users
constraints: These are the internal accounts of the municipality

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to assign roles to municipality users
constraints: Possible roles: municipal public relations officer, municipal administrator, technical office staff member, external maintainer. You can be more specific on technical offices to run realisti scenarios following the official organizational structure of the municipality of Turin (https://trasparenza.comune.torino.it/media/2212/download)

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to select a location on the city map
So that my report is geolocated with latitude and longitude.
constraints: Reports must be tied to a specific location. Use OpenStreet Map (or any other derivative map based on it), standard layer
expected_behaviors: my report is geolocated with latitude and longitude

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to provide details for my report 
So that the the problem is classified correctly.
constraints: Mandatory fields: title, description,  category , photos (min 1 max 3).
expected_behaviors: the the problem is classified correctly

requirements.text:
As a municipal public relations officer
I want to review and approve or reject reports 
So that only valid reports are processed further.
constraints: Rejected reports must include an explanation. If accepted, the report is assigned to the technical office bound to the report category.
expected_behaviors: only valid reports are processed further

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to see approved reports on an interactive map 
So that I can know about issues in my area and beyond.
constraints: Map should be zoomable. When zooming out, reports can be grouped into a cumulative report for a better visualization (total number should be reported on the cumulative report). When zooming in,  reports can be seen separated, with their title and reporter name (or "anonymous" if this is flagged on that report).
expected_behaviors: I can know about issues in my area and beyond

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to choose whether to make my report anonymous 
So that my name is not shown in the public list of reports.
constraints: Anonymous option protects privacy. Choice made at issue description time.
expected_behaviors: my name is not shown in the public list of reports

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to see the list of reports assigned to me
So that I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done
expected_behaviors: I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to configure my account
So that I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence.
constraints: Citizens can  upload a personal photo, add their Telegram username and switch off/on email notifications in the configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence

requirements.text:
As a citizen/unregistered user 
I want to search for reports in a specific area by typing in an address
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports in that specific area.
constraints: You can choose how much to zoom in. The product owner will then provide feedback on the implementation.
expected_behaviors: I can easily explore and analyze existing reports in that specific area

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to modify roles to municipality users
So that the staff can be more flexible.
constraints: This story overwrites a previous answer given by PO on the Telegram chat. NB: 1) A municipality user can now have multiple roles, i.e. serving on more than one technical office. 2) Modification includes cancellation.
expected_behaviors: the staff can be more flexible

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member 
I want to update report statuses 
So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
constraints: At each status change, the citizen receives notification in the platform with the corresponding update. Municipal operators working on reports can also send messages to the citizens in the platform, to which the citizen can reply.
expected_behaviors: citizens are informed of the problem resolution process

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to reply to messages from municipal operators in the platform 
So that I can communicate directly about my report.
constraints: Two-way communication is possible within the platform.
expected_behaviors: I can communicate directly about my report

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to receive optional email alerts in addition to platform notifications 
So that I can choose the best way to stay updated.
constraints: Unless disabled in their configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can choose the best way to stay updated

requirements.text:
As a citizen/unregistered user
I want to browse a summary table of reports with filters 
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports.
constraints: Filters: by category, status, period of time
expected_behaviors: I can easily explore and analyze existing reports

domain_rules: Reports must be tied to a specific location using OpenStreetMap (standard layer).

Report categories are fixed: Water Supply, Architectural Barriers, Sewer System, Public Lighting, Waste, Road Signs and Traffic Lights, Roads and Urban Furnishings, Public Green Areas and Playgrounds, Other.
Report statuses are: Pending Approval, Assigned, In Progress, Suspended, Rejected, Resolved.
Rejected reports must include an explanation from the Municipality Organization Office.
Anonymous users' names are visible to staff but hidden in the public map view for citizens.
Only technical office staff members can have multiple roles.
External maintainers added by the system administrator must have their own individual account.
Comments exchanged between a technical office and an external maintainer are report-specific and reserved (not visible to citizens).
Communication between a technical office and external maintainers without access to Participium is out of scope.
Once a report has been inserted, it cannot be modified or deleted by the citizen.
The roles of 'municipal public relations officer' and 'municipal administrator' are automatically associated with the Organization Office.
Public statistics include number of reports by category and trends by day/week/month.
Private statistics (admin only) include detailed breakdowns by status, type, reporter, and top % of reporters.
Notifications/messages can be set to either real-time or on page refresh depending on user preference.
Automatic assignment of all issues of a certain category is possible only if previously set by the municipal administrator.
edge_cases: External maintainer resolves a report directly after moving it from Assigned to In Progress (Case 1).
Technical office staff member resolves a report manually when external company has no access (Case 2).
User zooms out on the map, causing reports to group into a cumulative view with total count.
User downloads a CSV while filters are active; only filtered data is included.
Citizen follows a report that was previously closed; system should prevent following or show as unavailable.
Telegram bot receives a command for a report ID that does not exist or belongs to another user.
assumptions: The 'Organization Office' is the central entity responsible for initial verification and rejection explanations.
Competent technical offices are pre-defined and mapped to specific problem categories.
Telegram bot integration requires users to have a valid Telegram username configured in their profile.
Email notifications can be fully disabled by the user in their configuration panel.
The system distinguishes between 'internal' comments (staff/maintainer) and 'public' updates (citizen-facing).
Unregistered users can view reports but cannot submit new ones or follow reports.
The map layer is strictly OpenStreetMap based as per the standard layer requirement.

authentication_notes: POST /api/sessions initiates login and creates session.
GET /api/sessions/current and DELETE /api/sessions/current manage session lifecycle.
POST /api/users registers citizen without auth; POST /api/sessions/verify activates account after email verification.
Most endpoints require authentication via active session created by POST /api/sessions.
Admin-only endpoints include POST /api/companies, GET /api/departments, and user management operations.
Citizen endpoints (e.g., PATCH /api/users/me) require authenticated citizen session.
Operations marked auth_required need an authenticated session during test setup.
dependencies: POST /api/users must precede POST /api/sessions/verify for account activation.
POST /api/companies must precede PATCH /api/reports/{id}/assign-external to ensure valid external maintainer assignment.
GET /api/departments/roles/mapping is prerequisite for POST /api/municipality/users to assign roles.
POST /api/sessions must precede all authenticated endpoints requiring session state.
PATCH /api/reports/{id}/status depends on prior report creation via POST /api/reports.
POST /api/users -> POST /api/sessions/verify: Verification requires a registered but unverified account.
GET /api/departments/roles/mapping -> POST /api/municipality/users: User creation requires valid department_role_ids from mapping endpoint.
POST /api/companies -> PATCH /api/reports/{id}/assign-external: External maintainer assignment requires existing company with matching category.
POST /api/sessions -> GET /api/sessions/current: Current user endpoint requires active session from login.
POST /api/reports -> PUT /api/reports/{id}/status: Status update requires existing report resource.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Unregistered user can view approved reports on an interactive map.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a GET request to /api/reports/map without any authentication headers or session cookies. Verify that the response returns a list of reports filtered by status 'Resolved' (or equivalent approved state) and that no sensitive user data (like full names for anonymous users) is exposed.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core public-facing functionality for unregistered users as per requirement PT28.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns reports to external maintainers.
strategy_items.prompt: Authenticate as a 'technical office staff member'. Attempt to assign a report to an external company that does not exist or has a category mismatch. Verify the API returns a 400 Bad Request error.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Ensure no external company exists with the required category.
Create or locate the resource referenced by the path parameter.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests validation logic for assigning reports to non-existent or mismatched companies as per requirement PT24.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns reports to external maintainers.
strategy_items.prompt: Authenticate as a 'technical office staff member'. Assign a report to an external company, then immediately attempt to assign the same report to a different external company. Verify the API rejects the second assignment.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Create two distinct external companies with valid categories.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify that the report remains assigned to the first company and is not reassigned; no cleanup of companies required.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the stateful dependency where a report can only be assigned to one external maintainer at a time, satisfying requirement PT24.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member updates report statuses.
strategy_items.prompt: Authenticate as a 'technical office staff member'. Update a report status from 'Pending Approval' directly to 'Resolved', skipping the 'Assigned' and 'In Progress' states. Verify the API rejects this transition.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Ensure a report exists in 'Pending Approval' status.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests state machine integrity to ensure reports follow the correct lifecycle path as per requirement PT11.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen registers with name and username to access the system.
strategy_items.prompt: Register a new citizen user with a unique username, valid email, and full name. Ensure the response indicates successful registration but unverified status.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core registration flow for citizens as defined in PT01.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen confirms registration with a code to activate account.
strategy_items.prompt: Verify the account created in PT01 using the verification code sent to the registered email. Ensure the session is activated and the user can now authenticate via standard login.
setup_needed: Execute POST /api/users with valid citizen data to create an unverified account (Requirement PT01).
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify the user is now in 'active' state; if a verification code was reused or invalid, ensure no duplicate active sessions are created for the same email.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the account activation flow dependent on successful registration (PT01).

strategy_items.requirement_summary: System administrator sets up municipality users.
strategy_items.prompt: Create a new municipality staff user (e.g., 'Technical Office Staff') with valid credentials. Ensure the request includes necessary role IDs obtained from the mapping endpoint.
setup_needed: Execute GET /api/departments/roles/mapping to retrieve valid department_role_ids for the user creation payload.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the created municipality user via DELETE /api/municipality/users/{id} if it was not intended to persist.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates admin capability to create staff users, requiring role mapping setup.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff exchanges internal comments on a report.
strategy_items.prompt: Post an internal comment on a specific report ID. Ensure the comment is visible only to authorized staff (auth_role: technical office staff member) and not exposed in public views.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Ensure a report exists with status 'Assigned' or 'In Progress' to allow internal commenting.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the created comment via DELETE /api/reports/{reportId}/internal-comments/{commentId} to maintain data cleanliness.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the secure internal communication channel for staff (PT26).

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen selects a location on the city map to geolocate their report with latitude and longitude.
strategy_items.prompt: Submit a new report request containing valid latitude and longitude coordinates derived from a user interaction with the city map. Ensure the payload includes required fields for location, category, and description.
setup_needed: Authenticate as citizen role via POST /api/sessions
Ensure active session exists for authenticated requests
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core functionality of geolocating a report using map coordinates as specified in PT04.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member sees the list of reports assigned to them for maintenance overview.
strategy_items.prompt: Retrieve the list of reports assigned to the current user. Ensure that only reports with status 'Assigned' and where the user is the assignee are returned.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member via POST /api/sessions
strategy_items.rationale: Confirms that assigned reports are correctly filtered and displayed to the technical office staff member.
